fixes.explanation: Yes, friend. The plan is to stop up the waters of the springs outside the city (2 Chronicles 32:3). Hezekiah consulted with his leaders and mighty men about it, and they helped him carry it out. Then many people assembled and stopped up all the springs and the stream that flowed through the land (2 Chronicles 32:4).

That's the boast, baker. Sennacherib asks, “Who among all the gods of these nations that my fathers devoted to destruction has been able to deliver his people from my hand?” (2 Chronicles 32:14). He's claiming not one of those gods has done it. Then he asks, “How then can your God deliver you from my hand?” (2 Chronicles 32:14).
